data.one_liner: Integrate Facebook Login across Android, iOS, Web, macOS, and Windows.
data.what_it_does: Provides a multi-platform solution for Facebook Login, user profile fetching, session persistence, and Firebase authentication integration.
use_when: You need Facebook sign-in for your Flutter application targeting mobile, web, or desktop.
You want to integrate Facebook credentials with Firebase Auth.
avoid_when: Your app does not require social sign-in or Facebook authentication.
You want a purely backend-driven or custom OAuth implementation without SDKs.
strengths: Comprehensive cross-platform support including Android, iOS, Web, macOS, and Windows.
Built-in support for Apple Limited Login, App Tracking Transparency, and OIDC tokens.
Direct integration support for Firebase Auth.
weaknesses: Requires platform-specific configuration for Android, iOS, macOS, and Web.
Desktop targets require manual initialization setup.
data.setup_notes: Requires configuring App IDs, Client Tokens, Android Manifest queries, iOS URL schemes, and platform-specific SDK initialization.

alternatives.name: firebase_auth
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you are strictly using Firebase Authentication providers and want an all-in-one Firebase-managed sign-in flow.

alternatives.name: sign_in_with_apple
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you only need Apple Sign In.

alternatives.name: google_sign_in
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you only need Google Sign In.
